preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resources sws JOIN resources sres ON sres.id = sws.resource_id AND sres.code = 'STANDARD_WORK_SETS' JOIN role_resources wc ON wc.role_id = sws.role_id JOIN resources wres ON wres.id = wc.resource_id AND wres.code = 'WORK_CATALOG' JOIN role_resource_operations wop ON wop.role_resource_id = wc.id JOIN operations o ON o.id = wop.operation_id AND o.code = 'UPDATE' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations x WHERE x.role_resource_id = sws.id AND x.operation_id = o.id) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT DISTINCT sws.id, o.id FROM role_resources sws JOIN resources sres ON sres.id = sws.resource_id AND sres.code = 'STANDARD_WORK_SETS' JOIN role_resources wc ON wc.role_id = sws.role_id JOIN resources wres ON wres.id = wc.resource_id AND wres.code = 'WORK_CATALOG' JOIN role_resource_operations wop ON wop.role_resource_id = wc.id JOIN operations o ON o.id = wop.operation_id AND o.code = 'UPDATE' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations x WHERE x.role_resource_id = sws.id AND x.operation_id = o.id);
